toolsmith.latest_changelog:
Toolsmith Version 1.2.14 - Updates To Science and Steel

Not too much to go into detail about! Just updates from Dio and Scientific Smithy, and added mod compat files!

  • Updated the Scientific Smithy Compat to also add the needed attributes from the tool head onto the Workpiece during a Reforge
  • Added Meteoric Steel compat! Meteoric Steel Nails are tiny better than Steel ones similar to how Meteoric Iron is a little better then Iron! Also the respective metal tools have proper shape patches now, so they look like proper steel tools!

expandedmoldsbalanced.latest_changelog:
Changelog:

  • Update to game version 1.21.0
  • The hoop mold can now be formed from the different clays and ouput different colors via the beehive kiln
    • If there is any request, I can release a version that makes the hoop mold be fire clay only in keeping with the theme of progression balance
  • The other molds included in this Lite version continue to use fire clay only to maintain the intended balance of progression
  • Removed some items from the language files that do not exist and caused crash in the handbook when SmithingPlus is installed

 

Source Mod Changelog:

  • Feature: All molds are now fully compatible with the updated colored clay forming changes
  • Tweak: Chisel & Wrench molds have been removed as they no longer align with the vision of the mod
  • Tweak: Minor selection & collision box issues relating to the large molds have been corrected
